summary_en: Annual dividend per share for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised to 118 yen from 110 yen forecast. Dividend policy shifted to progressive dividend with DOE of 4% minimum, replacing prior 40% payout ratio target, effective from fiscal 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Dividend Policy and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Riken Vitamin revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The year-end dividend per share has been increased to 63 yen from the previously forecasted 55 yen, raising the total annual dividend from 110 yen to 118 yen. This represents an 8-yen increase from the previous forecast.

Simultaneously, the company adopted a new dividend policy effective from fiscal 2027. The policy shifts from the prior target of a consolidated payout ratio of 40% or higher to a progressive dividend framework with a minimum DOE (Dividend on Equity, calculated as annual total dividend divided by average shareholders' equity at the beginning and end of the period) of 4%. Progressive dividend means the company will maintain or increase the per-share dividend amount from year to year.

The board of directors approved this change as part of a review of the medium-term management plan 2027. The company emphasized that the new approach prioritizes stable and continuous profit returns to shareholders while reducing sensitivity to single-year earnings fluctuations.
